snippet.title: "Sol Mates" v1.5 Showcase
snippet.description:
"As a Solar God, your immortal task is to cleanse the souls of the departed, combine them into a purified entity, and send them off to reincarnate on native planets."

This is a video I created to showcase a game I designed and worked on back in 2017 with a group of volunteer game developers.  "Sol Mates" is one of the first titles that is part of the "Legends of Saviors" series, a collection of different games all centered around the same lore, locations, characters, and systems of an entire gaming universe.

You can play it for FREE, here! https://roninyeti.itch.io/sol-mates
